Definition: A desktop harness for running governed AI agents against a user-selected local filesystem workspace.

Synonyms: bundled instruction root; release-managed instruction root
Definition: Release-managed agent OS files packaged inside the desktop app, including AGENTS.md, agents, docs, and framework files.
The user-selected local filesystem workspace that contains project execution state, packages, deliverables, and tool roots.
Project truth lives in git-tracked plain files, and decisions not in versioned files do not exist for reliance.
Interactive execution surface for persona agents selected from NORMATIVE or EVALUATIVE matrix cells.
Execution surface for operative task categories selected from OPERATIVE matrix cells.
The surface where the user enters the matrix navigation flow.
Humans approve, issue, sign, seal, decide, and accept outputs for reliance.
Snapshot-producing runs create timestamped folders that are not overwritten.
Each agent has an explicit write scope; derived outputs live in tool roots and source truth in deliverable folders.
Unknowns become TBD rather than guesses.

Synonyms: Anthropic SDK provider path; production provider mode
Definition: Provider execution path using the Anthropic SDK and allowlisted Anthropic API access.
A deterministic local test provider mode retained for testability.
Turn execution streams named JSON payload events over text/event-stream.
Model, tools, max turns, mode, persona, and governance metadata options supplied to turns or session boot.
UI labels map to canonical agent names such as HELP to HELP_HUMAN and ORCHESTRATE to ORCHESTRATOR.
Server logic that validates supported file types, regular-file status, symlink status, readability, and byte budgets before provider execution.
Electron encryption mechanism used to store API key material outside the working root.
Packaged builds verify instruction-root integrity as part of packaging and release validation.
A project root layout containing INIT.md, package folders, and tool roots such as _Aggregation and _Decomposition.
A DEL-prefixed folder detected with _STATUS.md and canonical metadata files.
Datasheet, Specification, Guidance, and Procedure files treated as first-class knowledge buckets.
Dependency register schema with 29 required core columns plus optional extension columns.
Forward-only actor-authorized transitions for _STATUS.md lifecycle state.
A 7-to-64-character hex SHA-like token required for CHECKING or ISSUED human gate transitions.
Subagent delegation that fails closed unless enablement, approval, context sealing, allowlist, and candidate-file conditions hold.
Tools indexed by tools/REGISTRY.md for scaffolding, validation, reporting, coordination, PDF-to-markdown, and evaluation.
Governed workflows requiring explicit approval tokens and SHA checks, with HEAD rechecked before approved actions.
Repeatable validation that creates a stable Section 8 summary JSON and is run locally and in CI.
The current concrete release target is macOS 15+ Apple Silicon arm64 unsigned local-builder DMG.
The current release packaging output is an unsigned, unnotarized macOS arm64 DMG.
JSON session storage under frontend .chirality/sessions or an override path from CHIRALITY_SESSION_ROOT.
Electron userData credential storage encrypted with safeStorage and not treated as project truth.
Policy that blocks renderer outbound traffic except loopback and the Anthropic API.
Per-file 10 MB and per-turn 18 MB raw-byte limits enforced before provider calls.
Outputs are not professionally reliable by themselves and remain drafts or decision support until human review.
PRD section where implementation gaps, risk decisions, and current-release exclusions are recorded.
PRD section mapping product areas to stable SOW and OBJ identifiers.
